documents.text: Production releases require approval from the service owner. Emergency releases require incident commander approval. All release decisions are recorded in the release log.
Priority one support tickets receive a response within two hours. Standard support tickets receive a response within one business day. Support coverage runs Monday through Friday.
Travel expenses must be submitted within thirty days. Hotel reimbursement is limited to 120 euros per night. International flights require manager approval before booking.
Application audit logs are retained for ninety days. Security incident records are retained for one year. Customer deletion requests are reviewed by the privacy team.
Employees may work remotely for two days each week with team lead approval. Working from another country requires separate legal review. Remote working equipment remains company property.

Production database access requires security team approval and multi-factor authentication. Temporary database access expires after twenty-four hours. Access requests must include a business justification.
